_what: Every column in the identity store (self-hosted GoTrue on Box C) that can hold a network address, and the value a write leaves in it. SYN-P2: every app notice says no network address is stored, and the identity store is inside that promise. tooling/ci/assert-app-yaml.mjs limb 10 refuses any column in `columns` that the trigger file does not empty on write, any `exempt` column the file does touch, and an empty list (COVERAGE LOST).
_measuredBy: A catalog read on Box C, counts and names only: every inet or cidr column and every column named ip, *_ip, ip_address, remote_addr or client_ip, in both databases of the stack (postgres and _supabase). The query is the first block of the trigger file's header. Re-run it after every GoTrue image upgrade: a new column is an address the notice would then wrongly deny.
_exempt: ⏱ 2026-10-02 · review 1 of #1140, finding 3. A column GoTrue READS BACK cannot be emptied on write: the value it compares would no longer match. Each is held empty another way, named in `heldBy`, with the read-back that proves it. limb 10 refuses a trigger on an exempt column's table, and refuses the MFA challenge address anywhere but here.

exempt.reason: GoTrue v2.189.0 internal/api/mfa.go (validateChallenge, verifyPhoneFactor) refuses a verify whose request address differs from challenge.IPAddress ('Challenge and verify IP addresses mismatch'), so any emptied value fails every MFA verify.
exempt.heldBy: MFA enrolment off on Box C (GOTRUE_MFA_TOTP_ENROLL_ENABLED, GOTRUE_MFA_PHONE_ENROLL_ENABLED, GOTRUE_MFA_WEB_AUTHN_ENROLL_ENABLED all false): no factor, so no challenge row. Turning MFA on is a privacy-notice change first.
exempt.readBack: SELECT count(*) FROM auth.mfa_challenges; -- 0 (READ-BACK 3 of the trigger file)
